name: io.github.The-RFP-Hub/rfp-hub
title: RFP Hub
description: Search Ethereum-ecosystem funding opportunities; submit one behind a human approval step.

environmentVariables.name: RFPHUB_API_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the RFP Hub API. Defaults to https://api.ethrfps.app. The origin of this URL is bound into every write approval.

environmentVariables.name: RFPHUB_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: RFP Hub API credential. Needed ONLY to submit; searching and fetching are anonymous and never send it. Setting it is what registers the write tool at all: without it tools/list returns two tools. A write-scoped key is recommended: its submissions land pending a reviewer's decision.

packageArguments.name: --state-dir
packageArguments.description: Directory for write approvals, rate-limit counters and the local audit log. Defaults to ~/.rfphub and must be writable — rate limiting fails closed. Pass it where this user has no writable home, and pass the same directory to `rfphub-mcp approve`.

io.github.the-rfp-hub/tool-descriptions.comment: SHA-256 over the canonical form of {toolName: description} for every tool this version registers, asserted against the code by packages/mcp/test/manifest.test.ts. It catches ACCIDENTAL drift between the published manifest and the shipped build within a version. It is NOT protection against a publisher who changes description, code and digest together — the defense against that is that every configuration example pins an exact, immutable npm version.
